subject: Problem installing Rattle and GTK+ on Mac

messages.author: 30316938218cb711
messages.subject: Problem installing Rattle and GTK+ on Mac
parts:
Hi!
I'm trying to wrap my head around this nice little program called R. I'm studying some data mining and found that Rattle would be of great use. So I'm trying to install it. And well... As a new user to R since yesterday, I'm not used to the lingo yet. I've tried to find a solution online but without success. I try to give as much info here as possible. These are the result from two of the times trying to get Rattle to work. I also tried to update all the packages - didn't work. If anyone have any ideas on how to fix this, I would be very grateful.

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Problem installing Rattle and GTK+ on Mac
parts:
Try the beta version to see if that fixes the problem:

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")

Also you can check http://rattle.togaware.com/rattle-install-troubleshooting.html

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
